related.title: 哈伯替換電池的壓降與自熱
related.titleEn: Hubble replacement battery voltage sag and heating
related.transfer: 沿太陽能陣列、電池、熱傳路徑與耗能載荷對照邊界。
related.transferEn: Compare boundaries across solar array, battery, thermal path, and payload demand.
related.why: 兩課都要求可複查的能量收支及狀態時間軸；請先找到證據格式的共通欄位。
related.whyEn: Both courses require a reviewable energy budget and state timeline. First find the evidence fields they share.
related.difference: 由開路電壓與有效內阻估計脈衝壓降、內部耗散並設計脈衝測試。
related.differenceEn: Estimate pulse sag and dissipation from open-circuit voltage and effective resistance and design a pulse test.
practice: 各選一個名義結果，保留輸入與來源。
對照介面、失效條件與資料解析度。
把一項驗證改編到另一案例，記下不可沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Select one nominal result in each case, retaining inputs and sources.
Compare interfaces, failure conditions, and data resolution.
Transfer a verification to the other case and document assumptions that do not carry across.

courses.overview: 比較太空熱控、供電與儲能中兩種案例的介面與驗證方法，並轉移一個工程判斷。
